identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a 'Flight Deck' logistics interface that feels like a piece of high-end cinema equipment itself. Industrial, high-contrast, and tactile.
anti_patterns: Gradients that look like candy (use gradients for lighting/glow only)

usage_rules.background: Use #1B1B1B as the global background. Do not use pure black.
usage_rules.primary: Use #F9982E ONLY for primary actions (Mark Out, Save) and active states. Do not overuse.
usage_rules.text: Headings in White (#FFFFFF). Body in #A1A1AA. Data in #E4E4E7.
usage_rules.borders: Use 1px borders in #3F3F46 to define structure. Avoid shadows for depth; use borders instead.

textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on the main background to reduce digital flatness.
Scanline effect (optional) on data visualization panels.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges or minimal radius (rounded-sm / 2px). No pill shapes for containers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Use 'flat' layering with border contrast.
visual_enhancers.glows: Use 'drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(249,152,46,0.5)]' for active states or critical alerts.

layout_strategy.grid_system: The 'Control Room' Grid. Dense, information-rich, minimal whitespace between data points, but generous padding inside containers.
layout_strategy.spacing: Compact gaps (gap-2 or gap-4) between panels. Large padding (p-6) inside panels to frame the content.
layout_strategy.mobile: Stack vertically. Buttons must be full-width (h-12 or h-14) for easy thumb access.

buttons.primary: bg-[#F9982E] text-black hover:bg-[#F9982E]/90 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#3F3F46] text-white hover:bg-[#3F3F46] rounded-sm

inputs.style: bg-[#1B1B1B] border border-[#3F3F46] focus:border-[#F9982E] rounded-sm text-white h-12

status_badges.style: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest px-2 py-1 rounded-sm border

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' for icons. Use 'Chivo' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts.
2. THEME: Override the 'dark' theme in 'index.css' with the palette provided above. Ensure 'background' is #1B1B1B.
3. LAYOUT: Build the 'Main Dashboard' using a Bento Grid. Key metrics (Items Out, Overdue) should be top-level cards.
4. INTERACTION: The 'Mark Out' flow should be a modal or drawer. Do not navigate away from the inventory list.
5. MOBILE: Ensure the 'Mark Out' and 'Mark In' buttons are fixed at the bottom of the screen on mobile devices (z-50).
6. DATA: Use the 'JetBrains Mono' font for all numbers (stock counts, dates).
7. VISUALS: Add a subtle 1px border to all cards. Do not use shadows for elevation, use color contrast.
8. NOTIFICATIONS: Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., 'Gear Marked Out Successfully').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly, only for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (sharp, tactile) relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable inside containers.
All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute.
